up: Show distinct IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against the Prostaglandin D2 receptor 2 (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5071). Only include compounds that have a canonical SMILES and an associated PubMed ID or DOI. For each result, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, assay description, IC50 value (standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation), and the target's ChEMBL ID, name, and organism.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.standard_relation,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5071'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
